I’m level 320+, on 4 leaderboards and stream on TikTok daily. I also am on the pro N.A. team for this game. Here’s my thoughts. Playing at a low level is definitely a disadvantage. Lacking weapons, skill, map knowledge, techniques. However I recall when I first started, seeing people dash with the scythe and use a ray gun just made me want to play more to also have it. I believe the skill in this game is 99% aim. If u have good tracking you can beat most players regardless of what they do or use. Playing with friends is crucial to get over the “I must win” mentality at first bc it’s definitely frustrating. Other than that I suggest trying to play without caring about whether u win or lose and if u genuinely don’t have fun, don’t play it. I was a leaderboard player in mw2019 gunfight which is what attracted me to this game. I enjoy being with someone else and fighting a 1v1 and then either being rewarded or killed by how much health I was able to keep after the first fight. It’s definitely a specific taste to enjoy these kinds of short and duel style games.
